description: Explore built-in playbooks without opening or creating a project. Search by query/category and follow nextOffset. Include projectId only to include that project’s private skills after an access check. Skills teach a method; they do not grant permissions or spend credits. Returns matching skill summaries and pagination information.

category.description: Creative playbook category to filter discovery results.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return in this page.

offset.description: Number of matching results to skip; use the previous response’s nextOffset for another page.

projectId.description: Project ID for project-specific access or skills; omit for general capabilities or built-in skills.

query.description: Search words describing the item or content to find.

name: playground_skills_discover

next.description: Suggested next action; it does not authorize spending.
